info.name: Datalastic Maritime Historical Live Tracking API

params.name: mmsi
params.description: Vessel Maritime Mobile Service Identity (9-digit number).

items.docs: Returns the latest real-time AIS data for a single vessel identified by uuid, mmsi, or imo - name, identifiers, country code, type and subtype, latitude, longitude, speed, course, heading, navigational status, destination, and position timestamp. Average response time is 0.005 seconds. Deducts 1 credit per request.

info.name: Pro live ship tracking with ETA

params.name: mmsi
params.description: Vessel Maritime Mobile Service Identity (9-digit number).

items.docs: Returns everything the basic /vessel endpoint returns plus estimated time of arrival (ETA), actual time of departure (ATD), current draft, and UN/LOCODE destination and departure ports. Average response time is 0.9 seconds. Deducts 1 credit per request.

params.name: uuid
params.description: Datalastic vessel UUID. Repeatable, up to 100 vessels per call.

params.name: mmsi
params.description: Vessel MMSI (9-digit). Repeatable, up to 100 vessels per call.

params.name: imo
params.description: Vessel IMO number (7-digit). Repeatable, up to 100 vessels per call.

items.docs: Tracks up to 100 vessels in a single call. Repeat the uuid, mmsi, and/or imo parameters for each vessel to track. Deducts 1 credit per successfully returned vessel.
